naslov: EuroLeague roundup: Zvezda beats Olympiacos, wins for Zalgiris, Partizan, and Dubai
tekst:
By Eurohoops team / info@eurohoops.net
Zalgiris secured a victory in Istanbul, marking their fourth consecutive win in the EuroLeague, after defeating Besiktas 83-67 on the road.
It is clear that the Lithuanians are in rising form, as they demonstrated in Istanbul, where they settled all matters in the first half, which they won 45-31.
The visitors even had a 25-point lead at the start of the last quarter (69-44), but Beşiktaş managed an 11-0 run to close the gap and avoid a heavy defeat in the end.
Azuolas Tubelis led with 14 points for Zalgiris, Marius Grigonis added 13, while Jonas Valanciunas recorded a double-double with 12 points and 11 rebounds. Carsen Edwards scored 11, and Saben Lee added ten points.
For Besiktas, Eugene Omoruyi scored 17 points, Wenyen Gabriel had 14, and Anthony Brown contributed 10 points along with nine rebounds.
Zvezda beats Olympiacos after a drama
Crvena zvezda achieved a significant victory in the tenth round of the EuroLeague, defeating Olympiacos away with a score of 62-57.
An incredible game was played in Athens, and Zvezda, after a dramatic match, defeated the European champion, showing they are seriously aiming for the elite this season.
The “red and whites” from Belgrade played an incredible first half, conceding only 22 points, and at one moment, Zvezda had a 22-point lead (46-24). However, little by little, the host reduced the gap, Evan Fournier got into form, and two minutes before the end, Olympiacos was only two points behind (57-55).
However, crucial points by Koloko followed, and then a three-pointer by Jones, which concluded everything in Athens.
Jordan Nwora had 18 points and 13 rebounds, while only Chris Jones also scored in double figures with 10 points. For Olympiacos, Sasha Vezenkov shone again, finishing the game with 27 points, while Evan Fournier added 12.
Dubai crushes Virtus in Bologna
Dubai secured another victory in the elite, as they defeated Virtus away with a score of 93-75.
Mfiondu Kabengele had 16 points and nine rebounds for the winning team, McKinley Wright also scored 16, Tornike Shengelia added 14, and Dwayne Bacon scored 13 points. For the home team, Aliou Diarra shone with 19 points and seven rebounds, while Wendell Moore scored 15.
Dubai continued with their excellent performances in the EuroLeague after a somewhat poor start, and by halftime, the visitors had a significant lead of 48-34. The lead only grew, and Virtus managed to slightly reduce the loss only towards the end.
Fifth victory for Partizan
The evening concluded with a victory for Partizan, who were better than Maccabi Tel Aviv with a score of 88-67 in front of their fans, despite being without the help of Kevarrius Hayes.
The host started the match excellently, quickly taking a 23-7 lead. Maccabi managed to quickly come back, narrowing the gap to 30-26, but after that, there was only one team on the court.
By halftime, Partizan extended their lead to plus 15 (50-35), and the host maintained the difference until the end, securing the triumph.
Ethan Thompson scored 16 points for Partizan, Lamar Stevens had 14, and Antonio Reeves added 13. For the visitors, Daniel Theis scored 11 points, one more than Yam Madar.
